title: Handle a bridge failure
summary: A request through the bridge can reject.
introduction: A request through the bridge can reject. Your task: Test the fallback by temporarily rejecting the handler.
learningObjectives: Test the fallback by temporarily rejecting the handler.
Explain the example for handle a bridge failure

blocks.text: A request through the bridge can reject. The renderer should show a useful message instead of leaving an unhandled error.

Use a local Electron project with electron installed as a dev dependency and main.cjs as its main file. Run with npx electron . after creating package.json and index.html. These APIs do not run in a web-page playground.

items: `textContent` reads or replaces plain text inside an element. It does not interpret the supplied words as HTML.
`querySelector` finds the first matching element. Check for a missing result when the element is optional.

blocks.text: A successful request shows the version. A failed request shows the fallback text.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Check that the target element exists in your real page. Do not display private internal error messages to the user.
